summary: Evaluates Python or Tscript expressions against DAT text or table cells, producing transformed strings, computed values, or a generated output table.

key_params.name: dat
key_params.note: Optional DAT containing per-cell expressions

key_params.name: datexpr
key_params.note: Evaluate expressions from the DAT parameter instead of the Expression parameter

key_params.name: output
key_params.note: Choose expression, input cells, or expression table output behavior

key_params.name: expr
key_params.note: Python/Tscript expression used when no expression DAT drives the operator

key_params.name: outputsize
key_params.note: Control whether output follows input or expression table dimensions

key_params.name: dependency
key_params.note: Track expression dependencies so upstream changes recook this DAT

key_params.name: xfirstrow
key_params.note: Exclude the first row from scoped evaluation

key_params.name: xfirstcol
key_params.note: Exclude the first column from scoped evaluation

key_params.name: extractrows
key_params.note: Select which input rows are processed

key_params.name: extractcols
key_params.note: Select which input columns are processed

key_params.name: backslash
key_params.note: Convert backslash escape sequences such as newlines and tabs

key_params.name: rownamestart
key_params.note: Start row name for extracted/evaluated rows

key_params.name: rowindexstart
key_params.note: Start row index for extracted/evaluated rows

key_params.name: rownameend
key_params.note: End row name for extracted/evaluated rows

key_params.name: rowindexend
key_params.note: End row index for extracted/evaluated rows

key_params.name: rownames
key_params.note: Pattern of row names to include

key_params.name: rowexpr
key_params.note: Expression that selects rows to include

key_params.name: fromcol
key_params.note: Column used when evaluating row expressions

key_params.name: colnamestart
key_params.note: Start column name for extracted/evaluated columns

key_params.name: colindexstart
key_params.note: Start column index for extracted/evaluated columns

key_params.name: colnameend
key_params.note: End column name for extracted/evaluated columns

key_params.name: colindexend
key_params.note: End column index for extracted/evaluated columns

key_params.name: colnames
key_params.note: Pattern of column names to include

key_params.name: colexpr
key_params.note: Expression that selects columns to include

key_params.name: fromrow
key_params.note: Row used when evaluating column expressions

key_params.name: language
key_params.note: Common DAT script-language selection

key_params.name: extension
key_params.note: Edit/view file extension exposed to external editors

key_params.name: customext
key_params.note: Custom editor extension when Extension is set to Custom Extension

key_params.name: wordwrap
key_params.note: Common DAT node-display word wrap setting

common_gotchas: With an input DAT, the default output size follows the input rows and columns unless Output Table Size overrides it.
Expression tables smaller than the input repeat their last row or column, which can silently reuse formulas.
Use me.inputCell, me.inputRow, me.inputCol, NR, and NC intentionally; generated expressions should be explicit about cell context.
Backslash conversion can replace newline and tab escape sequences with spaces in table output.
key_concepts: Evaluates expressions over input DAT cells and writes the evaluated results to text or table output.
Expression evaluation can use local helpers such as input cells and row/column context.
Row and column extraction parameters restrict which table regions are evaluated.
An optional expression DAT can provide per-cell expressions, repeating the last available row or column when smaller.
